content:
Use START FRAME LOCK + IDENTITY LOCK + ENVIRONMENT LOCK in Seedance 2.0 for a 10s clip to keep the character and background consistent across the whole shot.  
Set Image A as the absolute character reference (start frame) and specify “maintain 100% identity” for face, hat/helmet, armor, katana, body proportions, materials, clothing physics, and colors.  
Set Image B as the absolute environment reference and specify “maintain” key elements (gigantic blood moon, burning Japanese castle, smoke/ash/embers, scorched battlefield, broken spears) plus cinematic lighting and dark red color grading.  
Direct camera motion explicitly with parameters like Ultra Low Angle (5 cm above ground), Ground Tracking, Slow Forward Dolly, Natural Camera Inertia, then transition to Slow Crane Up, Slow Orbit/left-rear move, and a Crash Zoom for emphasis.  
Storyboard the prompt with timestamped beats (e.g., 0:00–0:05 walk/feet-only, 0:05–0:07 stop + crane up, 0:07–0:10 orbit + breath + hand on katana + crash zoom + hard cut to black) to control pacing and shot progression.  
Add SFX instructions (heavy wind, fire, footsteps, armor creaks, breathing, tsuba click, taiko hit) and specify “no music” where needed to shape the audio track.  
Include stability/negative constraints like Stable Characters, No Character Deformation, No Weapon Deformation, No Duplicate Characters, No Magic, No Teleportation, No Anime Style to reduce artifacts and unwanted changes.  
Use style tags such as Ultra Photorealistic, IMAX Cinematic, Volumetric Lighting, HDR, Physically Accurate Fire, Realistic Smoke, Realistic Embers to push realism and cinematic look.

Usa START FRAME LOCK + IDENTITY LOCK + ENVIRONMENT LOCK en Seedance 2.0 para un clip de 10 s y mantener al personaje y el fondo consistentes durante toda la toma.  
Configura la Image A como la referencia absoluta del personaje (start frame) y especifica “maintain 100% identity” para el rostro, el casco, la armadura, la katana, las proporciones corporales, los materiales, la física de la ropa y los colores.  
Configura la Image B como la referencia absoluta del entorno y especifica “maintain” para los elementos clave (gigantic blood moon, burning Japanese castle, smoke/ash/embers, scorched battlefield, broken spears), además de cinematic lighting y dark red color grading.  
Dirige el movimiento de cámara de forma explícita con parámetros como Ultra Low Angle (5 cm above ground), Ground Tracking, Slow Forward Dolly, Natural Camera Inertia, y luego transiciona a Slow Crane Up, Slow Orbit/left-rear move, y un Crash Zoom para enfatizar.  
Estructura el prompt con beats marcados por tiempo (por ejemplo, 0:00–0:05 walk/feet-only, 0:05–0:07 stop + crane up, 0:07–0:10 orbit + breath + hand on katana + crash zoom + hard cut to black) para controlar el ritmo y la progresión de la toma.  
Añade instrucciones de SFX (heavy wind, fire, footsteps, armor creaks, breathing, tsuba click, taiko hit) y especifica “no music” cuando sea necesario para moldear la pista de audio.  
Incluye restricciones de estabilidad/negativas como Stable Characters, No Character Deformation, No Weapon Deformation, No Duplicate Characters, No Magic, No Teleportation, No Anime Style para reducir artefactos y cambios no deseados.  
Usa etiquetas de estilo como Ultra Photorealistic, IMAX Cinematic, Volumetric Lighting, HDR, Physically Accurate Fire, Realistic Smoke, Realistic Embers para potenciar el realismo y el aspecto cinematográfico.

--- CONTINUACIÓN DEL HILO ---

Définissez Image A comme référence absolue du personnage (start frame) et spécifiez « maintain 100% identity » pour le visage, le chapeau/casque, l’armure, le katana, les proportions du corps, les matériaux, la physique des vêtements et les couleurs.  
Définissez Image B comme référence absolue de l’environnement et spécifiez « maintain » pour les éléments clés (gigantesque blood moon, château japonais en flammes, smoke/ash/embers, champ de bataille calciné, lances brisées), ainsi que l’éclairage cinématique et le color grading rouge sombre.  
Dirigez explicitement le mouvement de caméra avec des paramètres comme Ultra Low Angle (5 cm above ground), Ground Tracking, Slow Forward Dolly, Natural Camera Inertia, puis enchaînez avec Slow Crane Up, Slow Orbit/move left-rear, et un Crash Zoom pour accentuer l’effet.

Ajoutez des instructions SFX (heavy wind, fire, footsteps, armor creaks, breathing, tsuba click, taiko hit) et précisez « no music » lorsque nécessaire pour façonner la piste audio.  
Incluez des contraintes de stabilité/négatives comme Stable Characters, No Character Deformation, No Weapon Deformation, No Duplicate Characters, No Magic, No Teleportation, No Anime Style afin de réduire les artefacts et les changements indésirables.  
Utilisez des tags de style tels que Ultra Photorealistic, IMAX Cinematic, Volumetric Lighting, HDR, Physically Accurate Fire, Realistic Smoke, Realistic Embers pour pousser le réalisme et l’aspect cinématographique.

Seedance 2.0 で START FRAME LOCK + IDENTITY LOCK + ENVIRONMENT LOCK を使い、10秒クリップ全体でキャラクターと背景の一貫性を保つ。  
画像Aを絶対的なキャラクター参照（開始フレーム）として設定し、顔、帽子/兜、鎧、刀、体のプロポーション、素材、衣服の物理挙動、色彩について「100% identity を維持」と指定する。  
画像Bを絶対的な環境参照として設定し、巨大な血月、燃える日本の城、煙/灰/火の粉、焦土の戦場、折れた槍といった主要要素に加え、cinematic lighting と dark red の color grading を「維持」と指定する。  
Ultra Low Angle（地面から5cm）、Ground Tracking、Slow Forward Dolly、Natural Camera Inertia などのパラメータでカメラの動きを明示し、その後 Slow Crane Up、Slow Orbit/左後方への移動、強調用の Crash Zoom へつなげる。  
タイムスタンプ付きのビート（例: 0:00–0:05 歩行/足元のみ、0:05–0:07 停止 + crane up、0:07–0:10 orbit + 呼吸 + 刀に手を置く + crash zoom + hard cut to black）で prompt をストーリーボード化し、テンポとショットの進行を制御する。  
SFX 指示（強風、炎、足音、鎧の軋み、呼吸、tsuba のクリック音、太鼓の一打）を追加し、必要に応じて「no music」を指定して音声トラックを形作る。  
Stable Characters、No Character Deformation、No Weapon Deformation、No Duplicate Characters、No Magic、No Teleportation、No Anime Style などの安定性/ネガティブ制約を含め、アーティファクトや不要な変化を減らす。  
Ultra Photorealistic、IMAX Cinematic、Volumetric Lighting、HDR、Physically Accurate Fire、Realistic Smoke、Realistic Embers などの style tags を使って、リアリズムと cinematic な見た目を強める。

이미지 B를 절대적인 환경 참조로 설정하고, 거대한 혈월, 불타는 일본 성, 연기/재, 불씨, 그을린 전장, 부러진 창 같은 핵심 요소와 시네마틱 조명, 짙은 붉은색 컬러 그레이딩을 “유지”하도록 지정하세요.  
Ultra Low Angle(지면에서 5cm), Ground Tracking, Slow Forward Dolly, Natural Camera Inertia 같은 파라미터로 카메라 움직임을 명시적으로 지시한 뒤, Slow Crane Up, Slow Orbit/left-rear move, 그리고 강조를 위한 Crash Zoom으로 전환하세요.  
타임스탬프가 있는 비트(예: 0:00–0:05 걷기/발만 보이기, 0:05–0:07 정지 + crane up, 0:07–0:10 orbit + 호흡 + 카타나에 손 + crash zoom + hard cut to black)로 prompt를 스토리보드화해 페이싱과 샷 진행을 제어하세요.  
SFX 지시(강한 바람, 불, 발걸음, 갑옷 삐걱거림, 호흡, tsuba click, taiko hit)를 추가하고, 필요한 경우 “no music”을 명시해 오디오 트랙의 분위기를 조절하세요.  
아티팩트와 원치 않는 변화를 줄이기 위해 Stable Characters, No Character Deformation, No Weapon Deformation, No Duplicate Characters, No Magic, No Teleportation, No Anime Style 같은 안정성/네거티브 제약을 포함하세요.  
Ultra Photorealistic, IMAX Cinematic, Volumetric Lighting, HDR, Physically Accurate Fire, Realistic Smoke, Realistic Embers 같은 스타일 태그를 사용해 사실감과 시네마틱한 느낌을 강화하세요.

Use START FRAME LOCK + IDENTITY LOCK + ENVIRONMENT LOCK no Seedance 2.0 para um clipe de 10s, para manter o personagem e o fundo consistentes em toda a tomada.  
Defina a Image A como a referência absoluta do personagem (start frame) e especifique “maintain 100% identity” para rosto, chapéu/helmet, armadura, katana, proporções corporais, materiais, roupas em movimento e cores.  
Defina a Image B como a referência absoluta do ambiente e especifique “maintain” dos elementos-chave (gigantic blood moon, burning Japanese castle, smoke/ash/embers, scorched battlefield, broken spears), além de cinematic lighting e dark red color grading.  
Direcione o movimento de câmera explicitamente com parâmetros como Ultra Low Angle (5 cm above ground), Ground Tracking, Slow Forward Dolly, Natural Camera Inertia, e depois faça a transição para Slow Crane Up, Slow Orbit/left-rear move e um Crash Zoom para dar ênfase.  
Estruture o prompt com beats marcados por timestamp (por exemplo, 0:00–0:05 walk/feet-only, 0:05–0:07 stop + crane up, 0:07–0:10 orbit + breath + hand on katana + crash zoom + hard cut to black) para controlar o ritmo e a progressão da cena.  
Adicione instruções de SFX (heavy wind, fire, footsteps, armor creaks, breathing, tsuba click, taiko hit) e especifique “no music” quando necessário para moldar a trilha de áudio.  
Inclua restrições de estabilidade/negativas como Stable Characters, No Character Deformation, No Weapon Deformation, No Duplicate Characters, No Magic, No Teleportation, No Anime Style para reduzir artefatos e mudanças indesejadas.  
Use tags de estilo como Ultra Photorealistic, IMAX Cinematic, Volumetric Lighting, HDR, Physically Accurate Fire, Realistic Smoke, Realistic Embers para reforçar o realismo e o visual cinematográfico.

在 Seedance 2.0 中使用 START FRAME LOCK + IDENTITY LOCK + ENVIRONMENT LOCK，制作一个 10 秒片段，以确保角色和背景在整个镜头中保持一致。  
将 Image A 设为绝对角色参考（起始帧），并指定面部、帽子/头盔、盔甲、武士刀、身体比例、材质、服装物理效果和颜色“100% 保持一致”。  
将 Image B 设为绝对环境参考，并指定“保持”关键元素（巨大的血月、燃烧的日本城堡、烟雾/灰烬/火星、焦黑的战场、折断的长矛），以及 cinematic lighting 和 dark red color grading。  
通过 Ultra Low Angle（离地 5 cm）、Ground Tracking、Slow Forward Dolly、Natural Camera Inertia 等参数明确控制镜头运动，然后过渡到 Slow Crane Up、Slow Orbit/left-rear move，以及用于强调的 Crash Zoom。  
用带时间戳的节拍来编排 prompt（例如 0:00–0:05 行走/仅拍脚部、0:05–0:07 停下 + crane up、0:07–0:10 orbit + 呼吸 + 手按刀柄 + crash zoom + hard cut to black），以控制节奏和镜头推进。  
添加 SFX 指令（强风、火焰、脚步声、盔甲吱响、呼吸、tsuba click、taiko hit），并在需要时指定“no music”，以塑造音轨。  
加入稳定性/负面约束，如 Stable Characters、No Character Deformation、No Weapon Deformation、No Duplicate Characters、No Magic、No Teleportation、No Anime Style，以减少伪影和不必要的变化。  
使用 Ultra Photorealistic、IMAX Cinematic、Volumetric Lighting、HDR、Physically Accurate Fire、Realistic Smoke、Realistic Embers 等风格标签，以增强真实感和电影感。
